handback.title: Hotfix label builds a small fix without planning
handback.summary: A hotfix label lets a small fix skip planning, while code review, all tests and the merge gate still run.
handback.feature: An issue labeled hotfix builds from its text. Code review, all tests and the merge gate still judge it. Big ones return to planning.

stories.title: Hotfix issues build from their text and get reviewed
stories.user_story: A small fix labeled hotfix is built from its text, reviewed and gated, with no plan.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a code owner says work on an issue labeled hotfix, the worker starts with no plan.
acceptance_criteria.words: By hand, the owner's `/work` starts a hotfix's worker.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an issue labeled hotfix has no open blocker on autopilot, its worker starts instead of its planner.
acceptance_criteria.words: An issue labeled `hotfix` skips planning and plan review.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker starts, its pack gives the issue's text as the whole ask, with no plan.
acceptance_criteria.words: the worker builds straight from the issue's text: the text is the whole ask.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker changes a code file, the change stays on the pull request.
acceptance_criteria.words: the worker builds straight from the issue's text
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker finishes, code review starts on its pull request.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When code review judges a hotfix, its pack gives the issue's text as the ask to judge against.
acceptance_criteria.words: judges the diff against the issue's text
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When code review approves a hotfix pull request, all tests and the merge gate run, as for any pull request.
acceptance_criteria.words: All tests and the merge gate still run, as for any pull request.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker adds or changes a test, the change stays on the pull request.
acceptance_criteria.words: The worker may add or change a small test that pins the fix
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When code review finds a hotfix change bigger than the ask, the planner starts on the issue.
acceptance_criteria.words: When code review finds the change bigger than the ask, or the worker finds the ask needs a design choice, it goes back to normal planning, saying why.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When code review sends a hotfix back to planning, the issue gets a comment saying why.
acceptance_criteria.words: When code review finds the change bigger than the ask, or the worker finds the ask needs a design choice, it goes back to normal planning, saying why.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

stories.title: Hotfix pull requests labeled, linked and shown in one line
stories.user_story: A hotfix pull request is labeled and linked, design asks return, and its card shows one line.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker opens its pull request, the pull request carries the hotfix label.
acceptance_criteria.words: Every hotfix PR carries the `hotfix` label
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker opens its pull request, the pull request links the issue it answers.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker finds the ask needs a design choice, the planner starts on the issue.
acceptance_criteria.words: When code review finds the change bigger than the ask, or the worker finds the ask needs a design choice, it goes back to normal planning, saying why.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix worker sends the issue back to planning, the issue gets a comment saying why.
acceptance_criteria.words: When code review finds the change bigger than the ask, or the worker finds the ask needs a design choice, it goes back to normal planning, saying why.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an issue labeled hotfix is drawn, its card shows its state in one line.
acceptance_criteria.words: The card shows one line: the ask, the PR, the review verdict, the gate.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an issue labeled hotfix is drawn, its card line shows the ask.
acceptance_criteria.words: The card shows one line: the ask, the PR, the review verdict, the gate.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix has a pull request, its card line links that pull request.
acceptance_criteria.words: The card shows one line: the ask, the PR, the review verdict, the gate.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix code review ends, its card line shows the review verdict.
acceptance_criteria.words: The card shows one line: the ask, the PR, the review verdict, the gate.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a hotfix merge gate runs, its card line shows the gate's result.
acceptance_criteria.words: The card shows one line: the ask, the PR, the review verdict, the gate.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

non_functional.text: The hotfix parts of the worker and reviewer prompts name nothing about Dokima's own repo.
non_functional.why: Dokima runs on any repo, so its prompts must fit any repo.
non_functional.words: keep the prompts free of anything about Dokima's own repo, so they fit any repo.
non_functional.no_edge_cases: Its planner lists the edge cases with their tests when it plans this story.

answers.why: A new story 1 criterion keeps the hotfix worker's code change on the pull request.
Split into two criteria: code review starts, and its pack gives the issue's text to judge against.
